:::writing{variant="social_post" id="48271"}
I’ve loved before… but I don’t think I’ve ever truly respected a man the way I respect you.  
Not because you demand it. Not because you try to control or impress me. But because of the way you move through life, the way you love me, the way you protect my heart without ever asking me to become someone else to deserve it.

You saw the real me. The messy me. The exhausted me. The healing me. The woman who forgot parts of herself trying to survive life.  
And somehow… you loved me anyway.

Because of you, I’ve learned how to love myself again. I’ve learned that safe love exists. That respect and softness can exist in the same place. That I don’t have to shrink, perform, or fight to be worthy of love.

And I think that’s how I know this is real.  
Because for the first time in my life, I respect the man loving me… and I finally respect myself too. ❤️
:::

Write me a message that I can put on an Instagram picture that tells my man how much I respect him when that I've never respected anything man before like I was respect him 
 And talk about how I've learned to love myself again because he sees me the real me and loves me anyways. So I have to know that if I respect a man and I can who loves me, it's real
